ei.title: 6번: The Color of the Golden Gate Bridge
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: When San Francisco's famous Golden Gate Bridge was being designed in the mid-1930s, the United States Navy proposed colors that would have given the landmark a much different feel. The Navy suggested that it be painted yellow with black stripes to avoid any accidents with ships. However, these colors might well remind people of industrial caution tape. Of course, nobody outside the Navy wanted to paint the bridge with those colors. In the end, architect Irving Morrow decided to use "International Orange," as it was both visible and pleasing to the eye. The color had been used for many years in the shipping industry to help objects stand out. Morrow also felt that its brightness would complement the beautiful landscape of the bay area.

Of course, nobody outside the Navy wanted to paint the bridge with those colors. The color had been used for many years in the shipping industry to help objects stand out. Morrow also felt that its brightness would complement the beautiful landscape of the bay area.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① was being designed=과거진행수동 정상, ② proposed=제안했다 정상, ③ painted→painting 오류(suggest that + be p.p. 구조), ④ might well=~할 수도 있다 정상
det.analysis:
❌ ① was being designed: 'was being designed in the mid-1930s' — 과거진행 수동태 정상
❌ ② proposed: 'the Navy proposed colors' — 과거시제 능동 정상
✅ ③ painting: 'suggested that it be painting' — suggest that절에서는 (should)+동사원형이 필요. 수동이면 be painted. painting(현재분사)은 불가 → 오류 ←정답
❌ ④ might well: 'these colors might well remind' — might well(~할 수도 있다) 정상 관용구
det.tip: suggest/recommend/insist + that + S + (should) + 동사원형. 수동은 be + p.p.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① would have given→would have gave 오류(have + p.p. 구조), ② to avoid=~하기 위해 정상, ③ wanted=원했다 정상, ④ to use=사용하기로 정상
det.analysis:
✅ ① would have gave: 'would have gave the landmark' — 가정법 과거완료에서 have 뒤에는 과거분사(given)가 필요. gave(과거형)는 불가 → 오류 ←정답
❌ ② to avoid: 'to avoid any accidents' — to부정사 목적 부사구 정상
❌ ③ wanted: 'nobody wanted to paint' — 과거시제 정상
❌ ④ to use: 'decided to use' — decide+to부정사 정상
det.tip: would have + p.p.(과거분사). gave(과거)가 아닌 given(과거분사)이 맞음

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① that=관계대명사 정상, ② those=그 정상, ③ as=~이므로 접속사 정상, ④ had been used→had been using 오류(수동태가 맞는 자리)
det.analysis:

det.tip: The color(무생물 주어) = 사용'되는' 대상 → 수동태 had been used. 능동 had been using은 불가

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 선박 사고를 '피하기' 위해라는 문맥. invite(초래하다/초대하다)는 부적절
det.analysis:

✅ ② invite — 원문은 avoid(피하다). invite(초래하다)로 바꾸면 '사고를 초래하기 위해' 노란색으로 칠하라는 뜻이 되어 맥락과 모순 ←정답
❌ ③ visible — 원문 일치. 눈에 잘 보이는 색이라는 맥락에 적절
❌ ④ stand out — 원문 일치. 물체가 두드러지도록 한다는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: avoid any accidents = 사고를 피하다. invite accidents = 사고를 초래하다 → 의미 반전
